channel.title: Hacker Warehouse - recommended hardware feed
channel.description: Curated RFID, NFC and SDR hardware for Google Merchant Center

item.title: Proxmark3 RDV4.01 RFID Research Platform - LF 125kHz + HF 13.56MHz
item.description: Proxmark3 RDV4.01 is the reference open-source platform for RFID research, protocol analysis and tag diagnostics. It reads and identifies LF (125 kHz) and HF (13.56 MHz) tags, including ISO14443-A/B and ISO15693, and pairs with the open-source RFID/NFC Toolkit for ATQA/SAK decoding and JSON output. Includes PCBA with shell, HF and LF antennas, two test cards, USB cable and SIM adapter. Intended for authorized testing of tags, cards and readers you own.

item.title: Proxmark 5 RFID Research Platform - LF + HF Protocol Analysis
item.description: Proxmark 5 is the next-generation open-source RFID research platform with a faster front end, improved RF power supply and broader protocol coverage than RDV4. Suitable for reading and analyzing LF (125 kHz) and HF (13.56 MHz) tags, bench diagnostics and firmware development. For authorized testing of cards and readers you own.

item.title: iCopy-XS Standalone RFID Reader and Analyzer with Touchscreen
item.description: iCopy-XS is a standalone handheld RFID reader and analyzer with a color touchscreen, no laptop required. It reads and identifies 125 kHz and 13.56 MHz tags in the field, supports card inspection, frequency detection and firmware-based workflows. For authorized testing and inventory work on tags and cards you own.

item.title: Flipper Zero Portable Multi-Tool for Sub-GHz, RFID, NFC and IR
item.description: Flipper Zero is a portable multi-tool for pentesters and hardware enthusiasts. It reads and inspects Sub-GHz remotes, 125 kHz and 13.56 MHz RFID/NFC tags, infrared signals and iButton devices, with an open firmware ecosystem and GPIO headers. Ships with the toolkit-compatible serial bridge for protocol-level tag identification. Use only on devices and tags you own or are authorized to test.

item.title: HackRF One Software Defined Radio - 1 MHz to 6 GHz Transceiver
item.description: HackRF One is an open-source SDR transceiver covering 1 MHz to 6 GHz with a half-duplex RF front end, SMA connectors and USB power. Used for spectrum observation, signal analysis, protocol research and RF education. It observes RF activity around 13.56 MHz but is not a tag-protocol reader. Operate within the radio regulations of your jurisdiction.

item.title: PortaPack H4M for HackRF One - Standalone SDR with Touchscreen
item.description: PortaPack H4M turns a HackRF One into a standalone handheld SDR: 3.2 inch touchscreen, navigation controls, headphone and microSD slot, plus a wide set of receive and analysis applications for spectrum work and RF education. HackRF One not included. Operate within the radio regulations of your jurisdiction.

item.title: CatSniffer Multiprotocol IoT Sniffer - Sub-GHz, LoRa, Zigbee and BLE
item.description: CatSniffer is an open-source multiprotocol, multiband board for sniffing and communicating with IoT devices. It covers Sub-GHz, LoRa, Zigbee/802.15.4 and BLE through replaceable radio modules, and runs open firmware for capture and analysis workflows. For research on devices and networks you are authorized to test.

item.title: GreatFET One Hardware Hacking Tool - USB Development Board
item.description: GreatFET One is an extensible, open-source USB hardware tool with two USB ports, GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART and logic-analysis style workflows. It is used for hardware bring-up, firmware development, protocol reverse engineering education and lab automation on your own equipment.

item.title: Cynthion USB Test Instrument - Build, Test and Monitor USB Devices
item.description: Cynthion is an all-in-one open-source instrument for building, testing, monitoring and experimenting with USB devices. It provides a USB 2.0 analyzer, a host/device emulation path and FPGA-based custom gateware support for protocol development and lab research.

item.title: USB Armory MkII - Open Source USB Computer for Security Research
item.description: USB Armory MkII is a full-featured computer in a USB stick form factor, designed for security research and embedded development. It runs Linux, supports hardware crypto, flash storage and a headless configuration, and is used for secure boot, key storage and portable lab workloads.

item.title: LAN Tap Pro - Passive Ethernet Network Tap
item.description: LAN Tap Pro is a passive Ethernet tap that requires no power: it passes traffic through while exposing a copy of both directions for monitoring and analysis tools. Use it on networks you own or are authorized to monitor.

item.title: RF Detector by ProxGrind - Handheld LF and HF Field Detector
item.description: RF Detector by ProxGrind is a compact handheld device that senses LF and HF RF fields, helping you locate active readers and confirm antenna output before field work. A practical pocket tool for installers, lab benches and RFID site surveys.
